findings.passage: Reps. Davis, Scott and Schofield also continue to advocate for protecting and expanding voting rights. They believe that every eligible citizen should have the ability to exercise their right to vote without barriers or discrimination.
findings.note: Joint press release issued in the names of Reps. Viola Davis, Sandra Scott and Kim Schofield on their shared 2024 session agenda. It speaks of voting rights and barriers in general terms and names no ID rule, no citizenship proof and no bill.
